meta.note: Expense ledger, the source of truth for money-out. The expense-management CLI is not included in this payload; edit this JSON through trusted local tooling that preserves its schema. Line shape: id, vendor, item, category, scope (business|personal|mixed), cycle (monthly|annual|quarterly|weekly), amount (number for that cycle, or null while unknown), status (needs-amount|active|cancelled|paused|free), optional source/note, and date (YYYY-MM-DD) on oneoffs. Only active and needs-amount lines count toward burn. The single example below is status cancelled so it contributes nothing; delete it once you have real lines.
